question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

The meeting was brought to a ________ (rapid) conclusion.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"rapid"** means happening in a short time or at a fast pace. (तेज़)

 
 
• **Example: **The **rapid** growth of technology has changed the world significantly.
 
 
 
• **"Hasty"** refers to something done with excessive speed or urgency; hurried. (जल्दबाज़ी)
 
 
• **Example: **They made a** hasty** decision without considering all the facts.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pervious** (छिद्रयुक्त): Allowing water or other substances to pass through.

 
 
• **Example:** The soil was **pervious**, allowing rainwater to seep through quickly.
 
 
 
• **Stubborn** (ज़िद्दी): Having or showing dogged determination not to change one's attitude or position on something.
 
 
• **Example:** He was too** stubborn** to admit he was wrong.
 
 
 
• **Grim** (कठोर): Forbidding or uninviting.
 
 
• **Example:** The future looked** grim **after the company announced layoffs.
